name: CYBIONYX InMotion
summary:
🔥 Experience your favorite games and movies in a whole new way! With immersive presence and a real 3D
  effect!
  
  🌟 Any PC game — now like VR, with real 3D! You're not watching from the outside — you're inside the
  game, and the world around you is alive and full of depth!

  🎮 No special VR games or mods needed!
  
  🌀 Total sense of presence. Turn your head — and the whole world turns with you.

  🎬 Movies and games in 3D, like the real thing. Any video comes alive in true 3D!
